result:
I've made the round-186 STORE-1a fixes, and they're waiting for C to check them in the browser. My targeted tests, typecheck, lint and Biome checks all pass. I haven't committed or pushed, and I didn't run the full test suite, verify or build, since those are the gate's job.

**What changed**
- **K1, inactive products** (`app/routes/products.$handle.tsx`): a product with `isActive === false` now gets the same 404 "Product not found" as a missing product. The check runs after the `try`, so the existing `catch` can't turn it into a 503. Products marked active, or with no `isActive` field, open as before, and the API 404 and other-error 503 paths are unchanged.
- **K2, meta description** (same file): the description now comes from `product.description`, with whitespace collapsed and a cut to at most 160 characters at a word boundary. Empty or missing descriptions fall back to `{title} — {type} by CZABA.` The same text goes into all three description tags. The helper is not exported, and nothing else in the meta changed.
- **K3, gift-card image** (`app/components/home/SpecialOffersSection.tsx`): the remote unsplash picture is replaced by the repo's `/images/gift-card.png`, with `loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"`. Text, link and layout are unchanged.
- **T1**: new test file with 12 tests, `app/lib/__tests__/product-handle-route.test.tsx`.
- **D1**: the Georgian implementation doc `153-store-1a-product-page-bugs.md`. One later text update to it was a small python string replace instead of Edit; that's disclosed in my report.

**Test results**
- **Targeted tests:** 3 files, 53 tests pass.
- **Against the original route code:** 8 of the 12 new tests fail. The other 4 check that existing behaviour is kept, so I proved them with 11 one-line changes to scratch copies of the route; each change makes at least one test fail. Scripts and outputs are in `a-round-186/tools/`.
- **Live check** (mock API plus the store on :5173):
  - `/products/archived-rain` returns 404 with no price or buy buttons, while the mock answered 200, so the store did the refusing.
  - Three active products return 200, and their description tags match the fixture text.
  - `/` makes no requests to unsplash.
- **Playwright at 1440×900 only:** the gift card loads at 1024 px wide, the only outside requests are Google Fonts, and there are no page errors.

The code-reviewer subagent scored the change 7/10 with no critical issues. I fixed both Mediums: the word cut missed a space at character 159, and one test was too weak to catch a wrong cut. I also added the missing edge cases and removed an implicit `any` from the tests.

**For B to decide**
- **Cut position:** I read "the last space at or before character 159" as position 159 counted from zero, so the kept text is at most 159 characters. The other reading is a one-character change.
- **Open Low:** when there's no space to cut at, the hard cut can split an emoji in half. Normal text, including Georgian, isn't affected. Fix it later or move it to `deferred_low_polish`.
- **Architecture note:** keep the helper in the route. Move it to `app/lib/` only if a second route needs the same cut.
- **Backend follow-up:** the backend should eventually return 404 for inactive products too, with this check kept as a safety net.

I started the mock myself because port 5199 wasn't listening, and I've stopped it, so C needs to start its own. I left the :5173 server alone. The protected and frozen files are unchanged (all 1009 hashes match), and `git status` shows only the 2 granted files modified and the 2 new files. I haven't run any of C's rows.

Full report: `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-186.md` (evidence in the `a-round-186/` folder next to it)
